Other words

  • probātiō quālitātis — quality testing

    also used · our formation

    Testing is one part of QA, so this and cūrātiō quālitātis are not exact synonyms. Both expressions recover proposals from our 21 September 2026 conversation. The dictionary sources establish the component words and their older senses; they do not establish these complete phrases as standardized software terminology.

See also quality assurance, tester, automated testing, manual testing, regression testing, integration testing, unit test, acceptance testing, test case.
